analysis.headline: No Data Selling or Sharing
analysis.quote: Further, Apple does not share personal data with third parties for their own marketing purposes. Apple does not sell your personal data including as “sale” is defined in Nevada and California. Apple also does not “share” your personal data as that term is defined in California.

analysis.headline: Collects Data From Others
analysis.quote: Apple may receive personal data about you from other individuals, from businesses or third parties acting at your direction, from our partners who work with us to provide our products and services and assist us in security and fraud prevention, and from other lawful sources.

analysis.headline: Uses Your Public Data For AI
analysis.quote: To power features such as search and as a source for our foundational AI models, Apple uses Applebot, a web crawler, to crawl information that is publicly available on the internet.

analysis.headline: Collects Your Child's Data
analysis.quote: To access certain Apple services, a child must have a child Apple Account. A child Apple Account may be created by the parent or, in the case of a Managed Apple Account, by the child’s educational institution.

analysis.headline: Transfers Your Data Globally
analysis.quote: To make that possible, your personal data may be transferred to or accessed by entities around the world, including Apple-affiliated companies, to perform processing activities such as those described in this Privacy Policy in connection with your use of our products and services.

analysis.headline: Tracks You With Cookies
analysis.quote: Apple’s websites, online services, interactive applications, and advertisements may use “cookies” and other technologies such as web beacons.

analysis.headline: May Deny Your Requests
analysis.quote: There may be situations where we cannot grant your request — for example, if you ask us to delete your transaction data and Apple is legally obligated to keep a record of that transaction to comply with law.

analysis.headline: Required Data For Services
analysis.quote: However, if you choose not to do so, in many cases we will not be able to provide you with our products or services or respond to requests you may have.
